notes.title: Service Opening Notice
notes.notes:
Dear Lord:

On June 17th at 8:00 (UTC+8), a new server 1143 will be launched.
On June 18th at 8:00 (UTC+8), a new server 1144 will be launched.
On June 19th at 8:00 (UTC+8), a new server 1145 will be launched.

We have prepared new server benefits for you, including "100 Gold, 10,000 Grain, 10,000 Wood, 10,000 Silver, and 10,000 Iron". Please check your mailbox, my Lord.
We warmly welcome your valuable suggestions and encourage you to share your thoughts with friends who also love Three Kingdoms strategy games.

Lords and Tactics Operation Team.

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Detailed update content:


I. Summer Event:
Event Time: June 19th to June 26th


Colorful Summer:
During the event, players can log in daily to select one item and receive multiple login rewards based on the selected item's multiplier. Rewards include advanced star plates, golden troop selection boxes, golden tactics selection, golden battle fragments, and other rare items.


Cool Summer:
During the event, players can complete designated tasks to light up lotus flowers and receive rewards. When the lotus flowers are connected in a line, players can earn a star. Accumulate enough stars to receive rewards such as summer coupons, advanced star plates, gold, and refining stones.


Summer Pilgrimage:
During the event, players can recharge any amount daily to receive summer coupons, golden troops, and gold. Recharge for 7 consecutive days to receive advanced star plates, gold, and troop tier stones.


Refreshing Rewards:
Players can participate in the turntable lottery activity during the event and freely choose tactics, troops, golden battle skills, and golden gear. Players can use summer coupons to participate in the lottery and complete tasks or use diamonds to buy chances. Players can draw up to 500 times per day and receive additional rewards for reaching the required number of draws during the event.


II. Other optimizations:


Fixed the bug where monthly recharges could not be reset.
Increased the rewards for the first pass of the Trial gameplay.
Increased the rewards for the first pass of the Pass the General gameplay.
Extended the Growth Fund rewards from level 80 to level 100.
